answer: Give each agent one locked work bond tied to a single hardware key. First, it registers that key and locks 25 tokens for 90 days. Second, it must finish 30 tasks, each rechecked by 3 established peers. Third, trust decays, 30 idle days halve it, and one failed check slashes 10 tokens and removes its vouches. A new identity starts at zero and cannot inherit old trust. 1,000 fakes would lock 25,000 tokens for 90 days and need 30,000 checked tasks, about 2,500 hours of work. Reputation should grow like a vine on a willow, slow and visible; a Sybil swarm is embers with no wood behind them.
